he.CustomsBookTypeID: kpi:fragments, insight:quality — numeric book type is part of the complete-line test that separates real lines from export fragments
he.CustomsItem_2_Digits: chart-tree, chart-chapters, chart-isr, kpi:chapters, insight:leader — chapter code, also part of the complete-line test
he.CustomsItem_4_Digits: kpi:fragments — part of the complete-line test; heading grouping uses the full code
he.CustomsItem_6_Digits: kpi:fragments — part of the complete-line test; HS6 grouping uses the full code
he.CustomsItemFullClassification: chart-tree, chart-decl, chart-chapters, chart-isr, chart-fan, kpi:leaves, kpi:headings, kpi:national, insight:national, insight:fanout — join key to the English file; check-digit suffix marks declarable lines, digits 7-10 mark national subdivisions
he.GoodsDescription: chart-tree, chart-other, table:top_heads, kpi:other, insight:other — chapter and heading names; 'אחרים' catch-all lines
he.FullGoodsDescription: skip: parent → child description path, free text and the column most broken by the export
he.MeasurementUnitID: chart-units — fallback unit code where the English file has none (only when unshifted)
he.MeasurementUnitDescription: chart-units, chart-usec — Hebrew unit names, taken from unshifted rows
he.MaslulMeasurementUnit: chart-units — used only as a shift check (a numeric value means the unit columns are aligned); its meaning is undocumented
he.CustomsItemEndDate: skip: unreliable in the Hebrew file (shifted text); the English file's end date is used
en.CustomsBookTypeID: insight:quality — part of the complete-line test
en.CustomsItem_2_Digits: insight:quality — part of the complete-line test
en.CustomsItem_4_Digits: insight:quality — part of the complete-line test
en.CustomsItem_6_Digits: insight:quality — part of the complete-line test
en.CustomsItemFullClassification: chart-units, insight:quality — join key to the Hebrew book
en.HierarchicLocation: skip: English twin of the Hebrew hierarchy labels (charted from the Hebrew file)
en.GoodsDescription: skip: English text; the page is Hebrew-only
en.MeasurementUnitID: chart-units, chart-usec, kpi:kg, insight:units — primary unit code (cleanly quoted file)
en.MeasurementUnitDescription: skip: English twin of the unit code; Hebrew names come from the Hebrew file
en.MaslulMeasurementUnit: skip: internal routing code for the measurement unit, no documented meaning
